title.ur: Insaan ko tafreeh ki zaroorat hoti hai

intro.en: Hisham visits his friend Ibrahim in hospital. The doctor told Ibrahim to change his lifestyle because his whole life is work. Listen for how they talk about the problem and the good advice.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Hisham apne dost Ibrahim se hospital mein milta hai. Doctor ne Ibrahim se kaha ke apna tareeqa-e-zindagi badlo, kyunke uski poori zindagi sirf kaam hai. Dhyan dein ke woh masle aur achhi nasihat ke baare mein kaise baat karte hain.
intro.ar: يَزورُ هِشامٌ صَديقَهُ إِبْراهيمَ في المُسْتَشْفى، فَقَدْ طَلَبَ مِنْهُ الطَّبيبُ أَنْ يُغَيِّرَ أُسْلوبَ حَياتِهِ لِأَنَّ حَياتَهُ كُلَّها عَمَلٌ. اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى كَيْفِيَّةِ حَديثِهِما عَنِ المُشْكِلَةِ وَالنَّصيحَةِ.

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ لله عَلَى سَلامَتِكَ يا إِبْراهيم.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh ʿalā salāmatika yā Ibrāhīm
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah for your safety, Ibrahim.
dialogue.ur: Allah ka shukr hai ke aap salamat hain, Ibrahim.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً لَكَ. أَنا بِخَيْر، وَالحَمْدُ لله.
dialogue.tr: shukran laka. anā bi-khayr, wal-ḥamdu lillāh
dialogue.en: Thank you. I am fine, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya. Main theek hoon, Alhamdulillah.

dialogue.en: What happened? Why are you here?
dialogue.ur: Kya hua? Aap yahan kyon hain?

dialogue.ar: أُغْمِيَ عَلَيَّ وَأَنا في الشَّرِكَة، وَعِنْدَما أَفَقْتُ، وَجَدْتُ نَفْسي هُنا في المُسْتَشْفى.
dialogue.tr: ughmiya ʿalayya wa-anā fish-sharika, wa-ʿindamā afaqtu, wajadtu nafsī hunā fil-mustashfā
dialogue.en: I fainted while I was at the company, and when I woke up, I found myself here in the hospital.
dialogue.ur: Main company mein tha ke behosh ho gaya, aur jab hosh aaya to khud ko yahan hospital mein paya.

dialogue.en: And what is the doctor's opinion?
dialogue.ur: Aur doctor ki kya raaye hai?

dialogue.ar: فَحَصَني الطَّبيبُ، وَقالَ لي: أَنْتَ بِخَيْر.
dialogue.tr: faḥaṣanī ṭ-ṭabību, wa qāla lī: anta bi-khayr
dialogue.en: The doctor examined me and said to me: you are fine.
dialogue.ur: Doctor ne mera mu'ayena kiya aur kaha: aap theek hain.

dialogue.en: What is the problem?
dialogue.ur: Phir masla kya hai?

dialogue.ar: الأَمْرُ عَجيبٌ جِدّاً، طَلَبَ مِنّي الطَّبيبُ أَنْ أُغَيِّرَ أُسْلوبَ حَياتي.
dialogue.tr: al-amru ʿajībun jiddan, ṭalaba minnī ṭ-ṭabību an ughayyira uslūba ḥayātī
dialogue.en: It is very strange. The doctor asked me to change my lifestyle.
dialogue.ur: Baat bohat ajeeb hai. Doctor ne mujh se kaha ke apna tareeqa-e-zindagi badlo.

dialogue.en: Change your lifestyle! What does he mean?
dialogue.ur: Apna tareeqa-e-zindagi badlo! Uska kya matlab hai?

dialogue.ar: قالَ لي: حَياتُكَ كُلُّها عَمَلٌ، لا تَرْويحَ فيها.
dialogue.tr: qāla lī: ḥayātuka kulluhā ʿamal, lā tarwīḥa fīhā
dialogue.en: He said to me: your whole life is work, there is no recreation in it.
dialogue.ur: Usne mujh se kaha: aap ki poori zindagi kaam hai, usmein tafreeh nahin.

dialogue.en: What a strange matter!
dialogue.ur: Kitni ajeeb baat hai!

dialogue.ar: صَدَقَ الطَّبيبُ، فَحَياتي كُلُّها عَمَلٌ، لا تَرْويحَ فيها.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqa ṭ-ṭabību, fa-ḥayātī kulluhā ʿamal, lā tarwīḥa fīhā
dialogue.en: The doctor was right, my whole life is work, with no recreation in it.
dialogue.ur: Doctor ne sach kaha, meri poori zindagi kaam hai, usmein tafreeh nahin.

dialogue.en: And what did he advise you?
dialogue.ur: Aur usne aapko kya nasihat ki?

dialogue.ar: أَنْ أَقْضِيَ العُطْلَةَ في بَلَدٍ جَميل.
dialogue.en: To spend the holiday in a beautiful country.
dialogue.ur: Ke main chhutti kisi khoobsurat mulk mein guzaroon.

dialogue.en: What a good piece of advice!
dialogue.ur: Kitni achhi nasihat hai!

q.en: Where did Ibrahim find himself when he woke up?
q.ur: Hosh aane par Ibrahim ne khud ko kahan paya?
q.ar: أَيْنَ وَجَدَ إِبْراهيمُ نَفْسَهُ حينَ اسْتَيْقَظَ؟

q.en: What did the doctor ask Ibrahim to change?
q.ur: Doctor ne Ibrahim se kya badalne ko kaha?
q.ar: ماذا طَلَبَ الطَّبيبُ مِنْ إِبْراهيمَ أَنْ يُغَيِّرَ؟

q.en: What does «العُطْلَة» mean?
q.ur: «العُطْلَة» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: أَيّامُ راحَةٍ مِنَ العَمَلِ أَوِ الدِّراسَةِ

q.en: What was the doctor's advice?
q.ur: Doctor ki nasihat kya thi?

options: أَنْ يَقْضِيَ العُطْلَةَ في بَلَدٍ جَميل

q.en: Which word means "he examined"?
q.ur: "Usne mu'ayena kiya" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني: كَشَفَ الطَّبيبُ عَلى المَريضِ؟

title.en: Sounds: hamza أ and madda آ

intro.en: A hamza followed by an alif is called a madda (آ). The sound is stretched long, unlike a single hamza (أ). Listen and compare the pairs.
intro.ur: Hamza ke baad alif aaye to usay madda (آ) kehte hain; is ki awaaz lambi kheenchi jati hai, jabke akeli hamza (أ) chhoti hoti hai. Sun kar dono ka farq dekhein.
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَتْ بَعْدَ الهَمْزَةِ أَلِفٌ سُمِّيَتْ مَدَّةً (آ)، وَيَكونُ الصَّوْتُ طَويلاً بِخِلافِ الهَمْزَةِ وَحْدَها (أ). اِسْتَمِعْ وَقارِنْ بَيْنَ الأَزْواجِ.

q.en: What is the letter آ called?
q.ur: Harf آ ko kya kehte hain?

q.en: Which word has a long آ sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi آ ki awaaz hai?

q.en: What does «آسِف» mean?
q.ur: «آسِف» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "he ate"?
q.ur: "Usne khaya" kaun sa lafz hai?

intro.en: Arabic has special words for asking questions: مَنْ (who), ما (what), ماذا (what), لِماذا (why), كَيْفَ (how), مَتى (when), أَيْنَ (where), كَمْ (how many), أَيّ (which), هَلْ and أ (yes/no questions). Example: «كَيْفَ حالُكَ؟» How are you?
intro.ur: Arabi mein sawaal poochne ke khaas alfaaz hain: مَنْ (kaun), ما (kya), ماذا (kya), لِماذا (kyun), كَيْفَ (kaise), مَتى (kab), أَيْنَ (kahan), كَمْ (kitne), أَيّ (kaun sa), aur هَلْ / أ (haan ya na wale sawaal). Misaal: «كَيْفَ حالُكَ؟» Aap kaise hain?
intro.ar: لِلْعَرَبِيَّةِ أَدَواتٌ خاصَّةٌ لِلسُّؤالِ: مَنْ، ما، ماذا، لِماذا، كَيْفَ، مَتى، أَيْنَ، كَمْ، أَيّ، وَهَلْ وَالهَمْزَةُ لِلسُّؤالِ الَّذي جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا. مِثالٌ: «كَيْفَ حالُكَ؟»

dialogue.en: Who is this? This is my brother.
dialogue.ur: Yeh kaun hai? Yeh mera bhai hai.

dialogue.en: What is this? This is a book.
dialogue.ur: Yeh kya hai? Yeh kitab hai.

dialogue.en: Why are you here? To study the sciences.
dialogue.ur: Aap yahan kyon hain? Uloom parhne ke liye.

dialogue.en: How are you? Fine, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Aap kaise hain? Theek hoon, Alhamdulillah.

dialogue.ar: مَتى تُسافِرُ؟ أُسافِرُ غَداً إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: matā tusāfir? usāfiru ghadan in shā'a llāh
dialogue.en: When do you travel? I travel tomorrow, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Aap kab safar karenge? Kal, insha'Allah.

dialogue.en: Where is the book? The book is in the bag.
dialogue.ur: Kitab kahan hai? Kitab bag mein hai.

dialogue.en: How many children do you have? Five children.
dialogue.ur: Aap ke kitne bachche hain? Paanch bachche.

dialogue.en: Do you hear the adhan? Yes, I hear it.
dialogue.ur: Kya aap azaan sun rahe hain? Haan, sun raha hoon.

q.en: Which word asks "where"?
q.ur: "Kahan" poochne ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكانِ؟

q.en: Which word asks "when"?
q.ur: "Kab" poochne ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الزَّمانِ؟

q.en: Which question word asks about a number (how many)?
q.ur: Tadaad poochne (kitne) ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ العَدَدِ؟

q.en: Which question word asks "who"?
q.ur: "Kaun" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الشَّخْصِ العاقِلِ؟

q.en: Which word starts a yes/no question like «..... تَسْمَعُ الأَذان؟»?
q.ur: Haan/na wale sawaal «..... تَسْمَعُ الأَذان؟» mein kaun sa lafz aayega?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ تُبْدَأُ بِها جُمْلَةُ «..... تَسْمَعُ الأَذان؟» لِسُؤالٍ جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا؟

title.en: Listening and speaking: daily life and holidays
title.ur: Sunna aur bolna: rozmarra aur chhuttiyan

intro.en: Practice asking a partner about work, study and holidays. Use the question words you learned: كَمْ (how many), مَتى (when), ماذا (what), كَيْفَ (how).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein apne saathi se kaam, parhai aur chhuttiyon ke baare mein sawaal poochne ki mashq karein. Jo sawaal ke alfaaz seekhe hain unhein istemal karein: كَمْ، مَتى، ماذا، كَيْفَ.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى أَنْ تَسْأَلَ زَميلَكَ عَنِ العَمَلِ وَالدِّراسَةِ وَالعُطْلَةِ، مُسْتَعْمِلاً أَدَواتِ الاسْتِفْهامِ: كَمْ، مَتى، ماذا، كَيْفَ.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً تَدْرُسُ / تَعْمَلُ في اليَوْم؟
dialogue.en: How many hours do you study / work in a day?
dialogue.ur: Aap din mein kitne ghante parhte / kaam karte hain?

dialogue.ar: كَمْ يَوْماً تَدْرُسُ / تَعْمَلُ في الأُسْبوع؟
dialogue.en: How many days do you study / work in a week?
dialogue.ur: Aap hafte mein kitne din parhte / kaam karte hain?

dialogue.en: When is the weekend?
dialogue.ur: Hafte ki chhutti kab hoti hai?

dialogue.en: What do you do on the weekend?
dialogue.ur: Aap hafte ki chhutti mein kya karte hain?

dialogue.en: How do you relax?
dialogue.ur: Aap apna dil kaise behlate hain?

q.en: Which question asks how many hours you work?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawaal kaam ke ghanton ki tadaad poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ عَدَدِ ساعاتِ العَمَلِ؟

q.en: What does «الأُسْبوع» mean?
q.ur: «الأُسْبوع» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which question asks about relaxing?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawaal dil behlane ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ طَريقَةِ الاسْتِراحَةِ؟

q.en: Which word means "day"?
q.ur: "Din" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المُدَّةِ مِنْ شُروقِ الشَّمْسِ إِلى غُروبِها؟

intro.en: A reading text about why people need recreation and what kinds of recreation are useful. Think first: do you relax sometimes? How?
intro.ur: Yeh ek parhne ka matn hai ke log tafreeh ki zaroorat kyon mehsoos karte hain aur kaun si tafreeh faida mand hai. Pehle sochein: kya aap kabhi dil behlate hain? Kaise?
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ حاجَةِ النّاسِ إِلى التَّرْوِيحِ وَعَنْ أَنْواعِهِ المُفيدَةِ. فَكِّرْ أَوَّلاً: هَلْ تَسْتَريحُ أَحْياناً؟ وَكَيْفَ؟

dialogue.ar: يُمارِسُ النَّاسُ بَعْضَ الأَنْشِطَةِ لِلتَّرْوِيحِ عَنِ النَّفْس.
dialogue.tr: yumārisu n-nāsu baʿḍa l-anshiṭati lit-tarwīḥi ʿan in-nafs
dialogue.en: People do some activities in order to relax.
dialogue.ur: Log dil behlane ke liye kuch sargarmiyan karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَطْلُبُ النَّاسُ التَّرْوِيحَ بَعْدَ عَناءِ العَمَلِ أَوِ الدِّراسَة.
dialogue.tr: wa yaṭlubu n-nāsu t-tarwīḥa baʿda ʿanā'i l-ʿamali awi d-dirāsa
dialogue.en: People seek recreation after the hardship of work or study.
dialogue.ur: Log kaam ya parhai ki thakan ke baad tafreeh talash karte hain.

dialogue.ar: فَالعامِلُ الَّذي يَعْمَلُ كَثيراً يَحْتاجُ إِلَى التَّرْوِيح، وَالطَّالِبُ الَّذي يَدْرُسُ كَثيراً يَحْتاجُ إِلَى التَّرْوِيح.
dialogue.tr: fal-ʿāmilu lladhī yaʿmalu kathīran yaḥtāju ilā t-tarwīḥ, waṭ-ṭālibu lladhī yadrusu kathīran yaḥtāju ilā t-tarwīḥ
dialogue.en: The worker who works a lot needs recreation, and the student who studies a lot needs recreation.
dialogue.ur: Jo mazdoor bohat kaam karta hai use tafreeh chahiye, aur jo talib-e-ilm bohat parhta hai use bhi tafreeh chahiye.

dialogue.en: Recreation is useful for the mind and the body.
dialogue.ur: Tafreeh dimaagh aur jism dono ke liye faida mand hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَيْسَ الهَدَفُ مِنَ التَّرْوِيحِ قَتْلَ الوَقْت، وَإِنَّما الهَدَفُ قَضاءُ الوَقْتِ في أَنْشِطَةٍ مُفيدَة.
dialogue.tr: wa laysa l-hadafu mina t-tarwīḥi qatla l-waqt, wa innamā l-hadafu qaḍā'u l-waqti fī anshiṭatin mufīda
dialogue.en: The aim of recreation is not killing time; the aim is spending time in useful activities.
dialogue.ur: Tafreeh ka maqsad waqt zaaya karna nahin, balkay waqt ko faida mand kaamon mein guzaarna hai.

dialogue.ar: لِلتَّرْوِيحِ صُوَرٌ كَثيرَةٌ مِنْها: القِراءَةُ، وَمُمارَسَةُ الرِّياضَة، وَالسَّفَر، وَقَضاءُ الوَقْتِ في الحَديقَة، أَوْ عَلَى الشَّاطِئ.
dialogue.tr: lit-tarwīḥi ṣuwarun kathīra minhā: al-qirā'a, wa mumārasatu r-riyāḍa, was-safar, wa qaḍā'u l-waqti fil-ḥadīqa, aw ʿalā sh-shāṭi'
dialogue.en: Recreation has many forms, among them: reading, doing sports, travelling, and spending time in the garden or on the beach.
dialogue.ur: Tafreeh ki bohat si soortein hain, jaise: parhna, kasrat/khel, safar, aur bagh ya sahil par waqt guzaarna.

dialogue.ar: وَأَلْعابُ الحاسوب، وَإِقامَةُ المُخَيَّمات، وَصَيْدُ السَّمَك، وَزِيارَةُ المَتاحِف.
dialogue.tr: wa alʿābu l-ḥāsūb, wa iqāmatu l-mukhayyamāt, wa ṣaydu s-samak, wa ziyāratu l-matāḥif
dialogue.en: Also computer games, setting up camps, fishing, and visiting museums.
dialogue.ur: Computer games, khaime lagana, machhli ka shikar, aur museum ki sair bhi.

dialogue.ar: يُفَضِّلُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ القِراءَة، فَفيها فائِدَةٌ وَمُتْعَة.
dialogue.tr: yufaḍḍilu kathīrun mina n-nāsi l-qirā'a, fa-fīhā fā'idatun wa mutʿa
dialogue.en: Many people prefer reading; in it there is benefit and enjoyment.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se log parhna pasand karte hain, kyunke usmein faida aur lutf hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ التَّرْوِيحِ المُفيدِ مُمارَسَةُ الرِّياضَة، لِأَنَّ الإِسْلامَ يَدْعو إِلَى القُوَّة.
dialogue.tr: wa mina t-tarwīḥi l-mufīdi mumārasatu r-riyāḍa, li'anna l-islāma yadʿū ilā l-quwwa
dialogue.en: Among useful recreation is doing sports, because Islam calls to strength.
dialogue.ur: Faida mand tafreeh mein se kasrat/khel bhi hai, kyunke Islam quwwat ki daawat deta hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: (المُؤْمِنُ القَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللهِ مِنَ المُؤْمِنِ الضَّعيفِ، وَفي كُلٍّ خَيْر).
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: al-mu'minu l-qawiyyu khayrun wa aḥabbu ilā llāhi mina l-mu'mini ḍ-ḍaʿīf, wa fī kullin khayr
dialogue.en: The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: (The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in each there is good).
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: (Taqatwar momin Allah ke nazdeek kamzor momin se behtar aur zyada pyara hai, aur har ek mein bhalai hai).

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ المُسْلِمونَ يُمارِسونَ الرِّياضَة. قالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطَّاب: عَلِّموا أَوْلادَكُمُ السِّباحَةَ وَالرِّمايَةَ وَرُكوبَ الخَيْل.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna l-muslimūna yumārisūna r-riyāḍa. qāla ʿUmaru bnu l-Khaṭṭāb: ʿallimū awlādakumu s-sibāḥata war-rimāyata wa rukūba l-khayl
dialogue.en: The Muslims used to practise sports. ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
dialogue.ur: Musalman kasrat/khel kiya karte the. Umar bin Khattab ne farmaya: Apni aulad ko tairaki, teer andazi aur ghurr sawari sikhao.

q.en: Who needs recreation, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq kise tafreeh ki zaroorat hai?
q.ar: مَنْ يَحْتاجُ إِلى التَّرْوِيحِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is the aim of recreation?
q.ur: Tafreeh ka maqsad kya hai?

q.en: Recreation is useful for:

intro.en: The fāʿil is the noun in the raised case (marfūʿ, with a damma ـُ) that did the action. Example: «يُمارِسُ النَّاسُ الرِّياضَةَ» - «النَّاسُ» did the action, so it is the fāʿil.
intro.ur: Fa'il woh ism hai jo marfoo' (pesh ـُ ke saath) ho aur jisne kaam kiya ho. Misaal: «يُمارِسُ النَّاسُ الرِّياضَةَ» - kaam «النَّاسُ» ne kiya, is liye yeh fa'il hai.
intro.ar: الفاعِلُ اسْمٌ مَرْفوعٌ، وَعَلامَةُ رَفْعِهِ الضَّمَّةُ ـُ، وَهُوَ الَّذي قامَ بِالفِعْلِ. مِثالٌ: «يُمارِسُ النّاسُ الرِّياضَةَ» فَـ«النّاسُ» فاعِلٌ.

dialogue.ar: الفاعِلُ: هُوَ الاسْمُ المَرْفوعُ الَّذي فَعَلَ الفِعْل.
dialogue.tr: al-fāʿilu: huwa l-ismu l-marfūʿu lladhī faʿala l-fiʿl
dialogue.en: The fāʿil: it is the raised noun that did the verb.
dialogue.ur: Fa'il: woh marfoo' ism hai jisne fe'l kiya.

title.en: How do we spend the holiday?

intro.en: A family talks together about how to spend the holiday. Each child gives an idea. Notice the future with سَـ: «سَأَقْرَأُ» I will read, «سَأَسْبَحُ» I will swim.
intro.ur: Ek khandaan mil kar baat karta hai ke chhutti kaise guzaari jaye. Har bachcha apna mashwara deta hai. Mustaqbil ke liye سَـ dekhein: «سَأَقْرَأُ» main parhoonga, «سَأَسْبَحُ» main tairoonga.
intro.ar: تَتَحَدَّثُ أُسْرَةٌ مَعاً عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ قَضاءِ العُطْلَةِ، وَيَقْتَرِحُ كُلُّ وَلَدٍ فِكْرَةً. لاحِظِ المُسْتَقْبَلَ بِـ«سَـ»: «سَأَقْرَأُ»، «سَأَسْبَحُ».

dialogue.ar: العُطْلَةُ عَلَى الأَبْوابِ، يا أَبا أَحْمَد.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿuṭlatu ʿalā l-abwāb, yā abā Aḥmad
dialogue.en: The holiday is at the door, Abu Ahmad.
dialogue.ur: Chhutti qareeb aa gayi hai, Abu Ahmad.

dialogue.ar: يا لَها مِنْ مُشْكِلَةٍ كَبيرَةٍ يا أُمَّ أَحْمَد!
dialogue.tr: yā lahā min mushkilatin kabīra yā umma Aḥmad!
dialogue.en: What a big problem, Umm Ahmad!
dialogue.ur: Kitna bara masla hai, Umm Ahmad!

dialogue.en: How will our children spend the holiday?
dialogue.ur: Hamare bachche chhutti kaise guzaarenge?

dialogue.ar: هَيَّا نُنادِ الأَوْلاد، وَنُناقِشْهُمْ في الأَمْر.
dialogue.tr: hayyā nunādi l-awlād, wa nunāqishhum fil-amr
dialogue.en: Come, let us call the children and discuss the matter with them.
dialogue.ur: Chalo bachchon ko bulayein aur un se is baare mein mashwara karein.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ طَيِّبَة. سَأُنادِيهِمُ الآن. يا أَحْمَد، يا فاطِمَة، يا طارِق، يا نَدى، يا بَدْر.
dialogue.tr: fikratun ṭayyiba. sa-unādīhimu l-ān. yā Aḥmad, yā Fāṭima, yā Ṭāriq, yā Nadā, yā Badr
dialogue.en: A good idea. I will call them now. Ahmad, Fatima, Tariq, Nada, Badr.
dialogue.ur: Achhi soch hai. Main abhi unhein bulati hoon. Ahmad, Fatima, Tariq, Nada, Badr.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ نَقْضي العُطْلَةَ يا أَوْلاد؟ نُريدُ آراءَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: kayfa naqḍī l-ʿuṭlata yā awlād? nurīdu ārā'akum
dialogue.en: How shall we spend the holiday, children? We want your opinions.
dialogue.ur: Bachcho, hum chhutti kaise guzaarein? Hum aap ki raaye chahte hain.

dialogue.en: I think we should travel to a beautiful summer resort.
dialogue.ur: Meri raaye mein kisi khoobsurat sair-gah (mausam-e-garma ki jagah) jana chahiye.

dialogue.tr: aḥsanta. wa mā ra'yuki yā Fāṭima?
dialogue.en: Well done. And what is your opinion, Fatima?
dialogue.ur: Shabash. Aur Fatima, aap ki kya raaye hai?

dialogue.en: I think we should make a garden for the house.
dialogue.ur: Meri raaye mein ghar ke liye bagheecha banana chahiye.

dialogue.ar: يا لَها مِنْ فِكْرَةٍ طَيِّبَة! فَلَيْسَ في بَيْتِنا حَديقَة.
dialogue.tr: yā lahā min fikratin ṭayyiba! fa-laysa fī baytinā ḥadīqa
dialogue.en: What a good idea! There is no garden in our house.
dialogue.ur: Kitni achhi soch hai! Hamare ghar mein bagh nahin hai.

dialogue.en: I prefer watching television programmes.
dialogue.ur: Main TV ke programme dekhna pasand karta hoon.

dialogue.ar: لا مانِعَ مِنْ مُشاهَدَةِ البَرامِجِ المُفيدَةِ فَقَط: ساعَةً، أَوْ ساعَتَيْن.
dialogue.tr: lā māniʿa min mushāhadati l-barāmiji l-mufīdati faqaṭ: sāʿatan, aw sāʿatayn
dialogue.en: There is no objection to watching useful programmes only: an hour or two.
dialogue.ur: Sirf faida mand programme dekhne mein koi harj nahin: ek ya do ghante.

dialogue.en: I will read many books during the holiday.
dialogue.ur: Main chhutti mein bohat si kitabein parhoongi.

dialogue.tr: sa-alʿabu, wa sa-aqra'u, wa sa-asbaḥu fil-baḥr
dialogue.en: I will play, I will read, and I will swim in the sea.
dialogue.ur: Main khelunga, parhunga aur samundar mein tairunga.

dialogue.en: A happy holiday, children!
dialogue.ur: Chhutti mubarak ho, bachcho!

q.en: The mother allows the television only for:
q.ur: Ammi TV ki ijazat sirf kis ke liye deti hain?

q.en: Which letter shows the future in «سَأَقْرَأُ»?
q.ur: «سَأَقْرَأُ» mein mustaqbil ki nishani kaun si hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى المُسْتَقْبَلِ في «سَأَقْرَأُ»؟

q.en: Who will swim in the sea?
q.ur: Samundar mein kaun tairega?

intro.en: «يا» is a particle of calling. It comes before the person you call, who is called the munādā. Examples: «يا فاطِمَة» O Fatima, «يا أَوْلاد» O children.
intro.ur: «يا» pukarne ka harf hai. Yeh us shakhs ke naam se pehle aata hai jise pukara jaye, usay munada kehte hain. Misalein: «يا فاطِمَة» ai Fatima, «يا أَوْلاد» ai bachcho.
intro.ar: «يا» حَرْفُ نِداءٍ، يَأْتي قَبْلَ الشَّخْصِ الَّذي نُناديهِ، وَيُسَمّى المُنادى. أَمْثِلَةٌ: «يا فاطِمَةُ»، «يا أَوْلادُ».

dialogue.ar: يا: حَرْفُ نِداءٍ، يَدْخُلُ عَلَى الاسْمِ المُنادى.
dialogue.tr: yā: ḥarfu nidā'in, yadkhulu ʿalā l-ismi l-munādā
dialogue.en: Yā: a particle of calling, it enters the noun being called.
dialogue.ur: Yā: pukarne ka harf, jo pukare gaye ism par aata hai.

dialogue.ur: Ai car chalane wale.

dialogue.ur: Ai Harun ki behen. (Maryam 28)

q.en: What does «يا بُنَيَّ» mean?
q.ur: «يا بُنَيَّ» ka matlab kya hai?

title.en: Speaking: how do you spend the holiday?
title.ur: Bolna: aap chhutti kaise guzaarte hain?

intro.en: Pair activity: look at the pictures (a man swimming, a man reading, a man watching TV) and describe how each one spends the holiday. Then ask your friend the same question.
intro.ur: Do logon ki mashq: tasveerein dekhein (tairta hua aadmi, kitab parhta hua aadmi, TV dekhta hua aadmi) aur batayein ke har ek chhutti kaise guzaarta hai. Phir apne dost se bhi yahi poochein.
intro.ar: نَشاطٌ مَعَ زَميلٍ: اُنْظُرْ إِلى الصُّوَرِ (رَجُلٌ يَسْبَحُ، وَرَجُلٌ يَقْرَأُ، وَرَجُلٌ يُشاهِدُ التِّلْفازَ) وَصِفْ كَيْفَ يَقْضي كُلٌّ مِنْهُمُ العُطْلَةَ. ثُمَّ اسْأَلْ صَديقَكَ السُّؤالَ نَفْسَهُ.

dialogue.en: How does each one spend the holiday?
dialogue.ur: Har ek chhutti kaise guzaarta hai?

dialogue.en: How does your friend spend the holiday?
dialogue.ur: Aap ka dost chhutti kaise guzaarta hai?

dialogue.en: He swims in the sea.
dialogue.ur: Woh samundar mein tairta hai.

dialogue.en: He reads a book.
dialogue.ur: Woh kitab parhta hai.

dialogue.en: He watches television.
dialogue.ur: Woh TV dekhta hai.

q.en: Which question asks a friend how they spend the holiday?
q.ur: Dost se chhutti guzaarne ka tareeqa kaun sa sawaal poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ صَديقاً عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ قَضاءِ العُطْلَةِ؟

q.en: What does «يَسْبَحُ» mean?
q.ur: «يَسْبَحُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "friend"?
q.ur: "Dost" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُطْلَقُ عَلى مَنْ تُحِبُّهُ وَتُصاحِبُهُ؟

q.en: Which sentence means "He watches television"?
q.ur: "Woh TV dekhta hai" kaun sa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَعْني أَنَّهُ يَنْظُرُ إِلى التِّلْفازِ؟

intro.en: A reading text about people who spend their free time in tents outside the city: where they go, how long they stay, and what they take with them. Think first: where do people like to relax, at home or outdoors?
intro.ur: Yeh matn un logon ke baare mein hai jo shehar se bahar khaimon mein waqt guzaarte hain: kahan jaate hain, kitni der rehte hain aur saath kya le jaate hain. Pehle sochein: log ghar mein dil behlana pasand karte hain ya bahar?
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ أُناسٍ يَقْضونَ وَقْتَ فَراغِهِمْ في خِيامٍ خارِجَ المَدينَةِ: إِلى أَيْنَ يَذْهَبونَ، وَكَمْ يَبْقَوْنَ، وَماذا يَأْخُذونَ مَعَهُمْ. فَكِّرْ أَوَّلاً: أَيْنَ يُحِبُّ النّاسُ أَنْ يَسْتَريحوا، في البَيْتِ أَمْ في الهَواءِ الطَّلْقِ؟

dialogue.ar: يُفَضِّلُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ التَّرْوِيحَ خارِجَ البُيوت، حَيْثُ يَقْضونَ الوَقْتَ في مُخَيَّمات.
dialogue.tr: yufaḍḍilu kathīrun mina n-nāsi t-tarwīḥa khārija l-buyūt, ḥaythu yaqḍūna l-waqta fī mukhayyamāt
dialogue.en: Many people prefer recreation outside the houses, where they spend time in camps.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se log gharon ke bahar tafreeh pasand karte hain, jahan woh khaimon mein waqt guzaarte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَخْتَلِفُ الوَقْتُ الَّذي يَقْضيهِ النَّاسُ في المُخَيَّمات، فَقَدْ يَكونُ لَيْلَةً واحِدَةً، وَقَدْ يَكونُ عِدَّةَ أَسابيع.
dialogue.tr: wa yakhtalifu l-waqtu lladhī yaqḍīhi n-nāsu fil-mukhayyamāt, faqad yakūnu laylatan wāḥida, wa qad yakūnu ʿiddata asābīʿ
dialogue.en: The time people spend in camps differs; it may be one night, and it may be several weeks.
dialogue.ur: Khaimon mein log jitna waqt guzaarte hain wo mukhtalif hota hai; kabhi ek raat aur kabhi kai hafte.

dialogue.ar: وَيَخْتَلِفُ المَكان، فَقَدْ يَكونُ عَلَى شاطِئِ البَحْر، أَوْ في البَرّ، أَوْ في الغابَة، أَوْ في الصَّحْراء، أَوْ بَيْنَ الجِبال، حَيْثُ الهَواءُ النَّقِيّ.
dialogue.tr: wa yakhtalifu l-makān, faqad yakūnu ʿalā shāṭi'i l-baḥr, aw fil-barr, aw fil-ghāba, aw fiṣ-ṣaḥrā', aw bayna l-jibāl, ḥaythu l-hawā'u n-naqiyy
dialogue.en: The place also differs; it may be on the seashore, in the countryside, in the forest, in the desert, or among the mountains, where the air is clean.
dialogue.ur: Jagah bhi mukhtalif hoti hai; sahil par, khule maidan mein, jungle mein, registan mein ya pahaadon mein jahan saaf hawa hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: يَخْرُجُ النَّاسُ أَيَّامَ العُطْلَةِ إِلَى البَرّ، وَيَنْصِبونَ في مَكانِ التَّرْوِيحِ الخِيام، وَيَحْمِلونَ مَعَهُمُ الطَّعامَ وَالشَّرابَ، وَوَسائِلَ التَّرْوِيح.
dialogue.tr: yakhruju n-nāsu ayyāma l-ʿuṭlati ilā l-barr, wa yanṣibūna fī makāni t-tarwīḥi l-khiyām, wa yaḥmilūna maʿahumu ṭ-ṭaʿāma wash-sharāb, wa wasā'ila t-tarwīḥ
dialogue.en: People go out in the holiday days to the open country, pitch tents in the place of recreation, and carry with them food, drink and means of recreation.
dialogue.ur: Chhutti ke dinon mein log khule maidan mein jaate hain, tafreeh ki jagah khaime lagate hain, aur saath khana, peena aur tafreeh ka saamaan le jaate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُفَضِّلُ فَريقٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَنْ يَكونَ قَريباً مِنْ شاطِئِ البَحْر، حَيْثُ يُمارِسونَ السِّباحَةَ، وَأَنْواعَ الرِّياضَةِ الأُخْرى، وَيَصْطادونَ السَّمَك.
dialogue.tr: wa yufaḍḍilu farīqun mina n-nāsi an yakūna qarīban min shāṭi'i l-baḥr, ḥaythu yumārisūna s-sibāḥa, wa anwāʿa r-riyāḍati l-ukhrā, wa yaṣṭādūna s-samak
dialogue.en: One group of people prefers to be near the seashore, where they swim, do other sports, and catch fish.
dialogue.ur: Logon ka ek giroh samundar ke kinare ke qareeb rehna pasand karta hai, jahan woh tairaki, doosre khel aur machhli ka shikar karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُفَضِّلُ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ مُشاهَدَةَ الطُّيور، أَوِ التَّصْوير، أَوِ المَشْي.
dialogue.tr: wa yufaḍḍilu baʿḍu n-nāsi mushāhadata ṭ-ṭuyūr, awi t-taṣwīr, awi l-mashy
dialogue.en: Some people prefer watching birds, photography, or walking.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log parindon ko dekhna, tasveer kashi ya sair karna pasand karte hain.

dialogue.ar: يَحْمِلُ النَّاسُ مَعَهُمْ إِلَى البَرِّ خِياماً، وَمَلابِس، وَكَثيراً مِنَ الطَّعام.
dialogue.tr: yaḥmilu n-nāsu maʿahum ilā l-barri khiyāman, wa malābis, wa kathīran mina ṭ-ṭaʿām
dialogue.en: People take with them to the open country tents, clothes, and a lot of food.
dialogue.ur: Log khule maidan mein khaime, kapde aur bohat sa khana saath le jaate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْضُ النَّاسِ يُعِدّونَ الطَّعامَ في بُيوتِهِم، وَيَضَعونَهُ في أَوانٍ. وَهُناكَ مَنْ يُفَضِّلُ إِعْدادَ الطَّعامِ في المُخَيَّمات.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿḍu n-nāsi yuʿiddūna ṭ-ṭaʿāma fī buyūtihim, wa yaḍaʿūnahu fī awānin. wa hunāka man yufaḍḍilu iʿdāda ṭ-ṭaʿāmi fil-mukhayyamāt
dialogue.en: Some people prepare the food in their homes and put it in containers. And there are those who prefer preparing the food in the camps.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log khana apne gharon mein tayyar kar ke bartanon mein rakh lete hain, aur kuch khaimon mein hi khana pakana pasand karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحْمِلُ النَّاسُ مَعَهُمُ الماءَ، إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ في المَكانِ ماء.

dialogue.ur: Agar jagah par pani na ho to log pani bhi saath le jaate hain.

intro.en: «لا» before a present verb means "do not". It is one of the words of prohibition. Example: «لا تَأْكُلْ خُبْزاً أَبْيَض» - Do not eat white bread. Notice the verb ends with a sukun ـْ.
intro.ur: «لا» jab fe'l-e-mudari' se pehle aaye to matlab hota hai "mat karo". Yeh mana karne ka lafz hai. Misaal: «لا تَأْكُلْ خُبْزاً أَبْيَض» - safed roti mat khao. Dhyan dein ke fe'l ke aakhir mein sukun ـْ aata hai.
intro.ar: «لا» قَبْلَ الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ تُفيدُ النَّهْيَ، وَهِيَ مِنْ أَدَواتِ النَّهْيِ. مِثالٌ: «لا تَأْكُلْ خُبْزاً أَبْيَضَ». لاحِظْ أَنَّ آخِرَ الفِعْلِ يَصيرُ ساكِناً ـْ.

intro.en: Describe places in three sentences (forest, desert, beach), put words in order to make sentences, and learn punctuation marks: the semicolon, the colon, quotation marks and the dash.
intro.ur: Teen jumlon mein jagahon ka bayan karein (jungle, registan, sahil), alfaaz ko tarteeb de kar jumle banayein, aur alamaat-e-tarqeem seekhein: nuqta-o-kama, do nuqte, iqtibaas ke nishan aur dash.

dialogue.en: It is useful to help people at work.
dialogue.ur: Kaam mein logon ki madad karna faida mand hai.

dialogue.en: I think we should go to a beautiful city.
dialogue.ur: Meri raaye mein kisi khoobsurat shehar jana chahiye.

dialogue.ar: لا مانِعَ مِنْ مُشاهَدَةِ البَرامِجِ المُفيدَة.
dialogue.tr: lā māniʿa min mushāhadati l-barāmiji l-mufīda
dialogue.en: There is no objection to watching useful programmes.
dialogue.ur: Faida mand programme dekhne mein koi harj nahin.

dialogue.ar: قالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطَّاب - رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْه -: عَلِّموا أَوْلادَكُمُ السِّباحَةَ، وَالرِّمايَةَ، وَرُكوبَ الخَيْل.
dialogue.tr: qāla ʿUmaru bnu l-Khaṭṭāb - raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu -: ʿallimū awlādakumu s-sibāḥa, war-rimāya, wa rukūba l-khayl
dialogue.en: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb - may Allah be pleased with him - said: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
dialogue.ur: Umar bin Khattab - Allah un se raazi ho - ne farmaya: Apni aulad ko tairaki, teer andazi aur ghurr sawari sikhao.

dialogue.ar: يُمارِسُ النَّاسُ بَعْضَ الأَنْشِطَةِ؛ لِلتَّرْوِيحِ عَنِ النَّفْس.
dialogue.tr: yumārisu n-nāsu baʿḍa l-anshiṭati; lit-tarwīḥi ʿan in-nafs
dialogue.en: People do some activities; in order to relax.
dialogue.ur: Log kuch sargarmiyan karte hain؛ dil behlane ke liye.

dialogue.ar: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى مَكَّةَ؛ لِأُصَلِّيَ في المَسْجِدِ الحَرام.
dialogue.tr: dhahabtu ilā Makkata; li-uṣalliya fil-masjidi l-ḥarām
dialogue.en: I went to Makkah; in order to pray in the Sacred Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Main Makkah gaya؛ taa-ke Masjid-e-Haram mein namaz parhoon.

title.en: Handwriting and spelling: the closed tā' (ة)

intro.en: The closed tā' (ـة / ة) looks like the pronoun hā' (ـه / ه) and both are pronounced as «h» when you stop. Example: «قَرْيَة» (village) ends in tā' marbūṭa; «أَبوهُ» (his father) ends in hā'. Copy the verse «إِنَّمَا المُؤْمِنونَ إِخْوَة فَأَصْلِحوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُم».
intro.ur: Taa marboota (ـة / ة) zameer ke haa (ـه / ه) jaisi lagti hai aur ruk kar dono ki awaaz «h» jaisi aati hai. Misaal: «قَرْيَة» (gaon) taa marboota par khatam hota hai; «أَبوهُ» (uske walid) haa par. Aayat likhne ki mashq karein: «إِنَّمَا المُؤْمِنونَ إِخْوَة فَأَصْلِحوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُم».
intro.ar: التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (ـة / ة) تُشْبِهُ هاءَ الضَّميرِ (ـه / ه)، وَتُنْطَقانِ هاءً عِنْدَ الوَقْفِ. مِثالٌ: «قَرْيَة» تَنْتَهي بِتاءٍ مَرْبوطَةٍ، وَ«أَبوهُ» تَنْتَهي بِهاءِ الضَّميرِ. اِنْسَخِ الآيَةَ «إِنَّمَا المُؤْمِنونَ إِخْوَة فَأَصْلِحوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُم».

q.en: Which word ends with a closed tā' (ة)?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz taa marboota (ة) par khatam hota hai?

q.en: Which word ends with the pronoun hā' (ـه)?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz zameer ke haa (ـه) par khatam hota hai?

q.en: How are both pronounced when you stop?
q.ur: Ruk kar parhte waqt dono ki awaaz kaisi hoti hai?

q.en: What does «أَبوهُ» mean?
q.ur: «أَبوهُ» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: A review of Units 1 and 2. It starts with a reading about Fatima, a student who also works, and then has questions about grammar and vocabulary: correct or incorrect sentences, mistakes, word meanings and question words.
intro.ur: Unit 1 aur 2 ki dohrai. Pehle Fatima ke baare mein ek matn hai jo parhti bhi hai aur kaam bhi karti hai, phir qawaid aur alfaaz ke sawaal hain: sahi ya ghalat jumle, ghaltiyan, alfaaz ke ma'ani aur sawaal ke alfaaz.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحْدَتَيْنِ الأولى وَالثّانِيَةِ. تَبْدَأُ بِنَصٍّ عَنْ فاطِمَةَ، طالِبَةٍ تَعْمَلُ أَيْضاً، ثُمَّ أَسْئِلَةٌ في القَواعِدِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ: جُمَلٌ صَحيحَةٌ وَخاطِئَةٌ، وَأَخْطاءٌ، وَمَعاني كَلِماتٍ، وَأَدَواتُ اسْتِفْهامٍ.

dialogue.ar: فاطِمَةُ طالِبَةٌ تَدْرُسُ في الجامِعَة، وَتَعْمَلُ في أَحَدِ مَصانِعِ المَلابِس.
dialogue.tr: Fāṭimatu ṭālibatun tadrusu fil-jāmiʿa, wa taʿmalu fī aḥadi maṣāniʿi l-malābis
dialogue.en: Fatima is a student who studies at the university and works in one of the clothing factories.
dialogue.ur: Fatima ek talibah hai jo university mein parhti hai aur kapdon ki ek factory mein kaam karti hai.

dialogue.en: She goes to the college by bus.
dialogue.ur: Woh college bus se jaati hai.

dialogue.ar: تَبْدَأُ الدِّراسَةُ في الكُلِّيَّةِ السَّاعَةَ الثَّامِنَةَ صَباحاً، وَتَنْتَهي السَّاعَةَ الثَّانِيَةَ بَعْدَ الظُّهْر.
dialogue.tr: tabda'u d-dirāsatu fil-kulliyyati s-sāʿata th-thāminata ṣabāḥan, wa tantahī s-sāʿata th-thāniyata baʿda ẓ-ẓuhr
dialogue.en: Study at the college begins at eight in the morning and ends at two in the afternoon.
dialogue.ur: College mein parhai subah aath baje shuru hoti hai aur dopahar ke baad do baje khatam hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: تَتَناوَلُ فاطِمَةُ الغَداءَ في مَطْعَمِ الكُلِّيَّة.
dialogue.tr: tatanāwalu Fāṭimatu l-ghadā'a fī maṭʿami l-kulliyya
dialogue.en: Fatima has lunch in the college restaurant.
dialogue.ur: Fatima college ke restaurant mein dopahar ka khana khati hai.

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ الغَداءِ تَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَصْنَعِ بِالقِطار. يَبْدَأُ العَمَلُ في المَصْنَعِ السَّاعَةَ الرَّابِعَةَ مَساءً وَيَنْتَهي السَّاعَةَ الثَّامِنَة.
dialogue.tr: baʿda l-ghadā'i tadhhabu ilā l-maṣnaʿi bil-qiṭār. yabda'u l-ʿamalu fil-maṣnaʿi s-sāʿata r-rābiʿata masā'an wa yantahī s-sāʿata th-thāmina
dialogue.en: After lunch she goes to the factory by train. Work at the factory begins at four in the evening and ends at eight.
dialogue.ur: Dopahar ke khane ke baad woh train se factory jaati hai. Factory mein kaam shaam chaar baje shuru hota hai aur aath baje khatam hota hai.

dialogue.ar: في الأُسْبوعِ الماضي أُغْمِيَ عَلَى فاطِمَةَ في الجامِعَة، أَخَذَتْها صَديقاتُها إِلَى المُسْتَشْفى، وَحينَما أَفاقَتْ فاطِمَةُ وَجَدَتْ نَفْسَها في غُرْفَةِ الفَحْصِ مَعَ الطَّبيبَة.
dialogue.tr: fil-usbūʿi l-māḍī ughmiya ʿalā Fāṭima fil-jāmiʿa, akhadhat-hā ṣadīqātuhā ilā l-mustashfā, wa ḥīnamā afāqat Fāṭimatu wajadat nafsahā fī ghurfati l-faḥṣi maʿa ṭ-ṭabība
dialogue.en: Last week Fatima fainted at the university, her friends took her to the hospital, and when she woke up she found herself in the examination room with the doctor.
dialogue.ur: Guzishta hafte Fatima university mein behosh ho gayi, uski saheliyan use hospital le gayin, aur hosh aane par usne khud ko mu'ayena kamre mein doctor ke saath paya.

dialogue.ar: حَضَرَ والِدُ فاطِمَةَ وَوالِدَتُها إِلَى المُسْتَشْفى. قابَلَ والِدُها كَبيرَ الأَطِبَّاء.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍara wālidu Fāṭima wa wālidatuhā ilā l-mustashfā. qābala wāliduhā kabīra l-aṭibbā'
dialogue.en: Fatima's father and mother came to the hospital. Her father met the chief of the doctors.
dialogue.ur: Fatima ke walid aur walida hospital aaye. Uske walid bare doctor se mile.

dialogue.ar: قَرَأَ كَبيرُ الأَطِبَّاءِ التَّقْريرَ الطِّبِّيَّ وَقالَ لِوالِدِها: فاطِمَةُ بِخَيْر، وَالحَمْدُ لله، لَكِنَّها تَحْتاجُ إِلَى الرَّاحَة؛ هِيَ تَعْمَلُ وَتَدْرُس. يَجِبُ أَنْ تَرْتاح، وَيَجِبُ أَنْ تَتَناوَلَ طَعاماً جَيِّداً.
dialogue.tr: qara'a kabīru l-aṭibbā'i t-taqrīra ṭ-ṭibbiyya wa qāla li-wālidihā: Fāṭimatu bi-khayr, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lākinnahā taḥtāju ilā r-rāḥa; hiya taʿmalu wa tadrus. yajibu an tartāḥa, wa yajibu an tatanāwala ṭaʿāman jayyidan
dialogue.en: The chief doctor read the medical report and said to her father: Fatima is fine, praise be to Allah, but she needs rest; she works and studies. She must rest, and she must eat good food.
dialogue.ur: Bare doctor ne tibbi report parhi aur uske walid se kaha: Fatima theek hai, Alhamdulillah, lekin use aaram ki zaroorat hai; woh kaam bhi karti hai aur parhti bhi. Use aaram karna chahiye aur achha khana khana chahiye.
